summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the two changes: (1) TV must hide correct answer on incorrect/stolen answers, (2) two-dice movement. Drove a full real game via public URL: host created room (tv-create-btn -> tv-room-code), 2 phones joined in separate browser contexts (390x844), game started, ~70 turn steps automated across roll/choose_stop/moving/choose_candidate/question/feedback/clue/rest phases. Verified dice rendering, dice sum movement, incorrect-answer hiding on TV, correct-answer display on TV, phone-side answer visibility, and the stolen-turn TV screen. ALL targeted assertions PASSED.

minor.issue: During feedback phase public_current() still sends correct_answer + bible_reference to ALL clients (incl. TV) even when was_correct=false. UI hides it correctly, but the answer is still visible in the WS/REST payload (devtools). Consider omitting these fields for the public payload when the answer was wrong/stolen.

action_items: Optional hardening: stop broadcasting correct_answer/bible_reference in public state when the answer was incorrect or stolen (currently only hidden in the UI layer).
Cleanup: components/Dice.jsx contains dead code - unused `Face` component (declares useState, returns null). Remove it.
critical_code_review_comments: Host.jsx FeedbackStage correctly branches: correct -> answer box, incorrect -> data-testid='tv-answer-hidden', stolen -> data-testid='tv-answer-hidden-stolen'. No answer/explanation/bible-ref text leaks in the TV DOM (verified by full body text search against the real question data).
game.py roll_dice(): d1/d2 both 1-6, dice_value = d1+d2, dice_values exposed via public_current; traversal uses the sum so pawn advance == sum (verified from=0 -> to=8 for [2,6]).

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend-only request; supporting REST used for verification, all 200s)

verified_assertions.incorrect_answer_phone_shows: PASS - FeedbackView shows 'RESPUESTA CORRECTA B. Josue', explanation and 'Josue 1:1'

seed_data_creation: Transient in-memory rooms 6059 and 6204 with players QAUNO/QADOS and STEALA/STEALB (in-memory only, no DB writes).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pattern: GET /api/admin/questions gives correct_answer per question id, and GET /api/rooms/{code} gives full public state (phase, current, dice_values, question id) - use these to drive/verify the game deterministically while acting through the UI. Steal window opens only in the last 5s of the 30s question timer and only for verify-purpose questions (character/location/event tiles).
